A '''planet'''<ref name="Helmet Collection 23" /> located in [[Wild Space]]<ref name="Timelines" /> was home to the trading and supply base [[Havoc Outpost]]. A terrestrial [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Helmet Collection 23" /> situated in [[Standard Galactic Grid]] square S-19,<ref name="Timelines" /> it appeared [[Color|bluish]] from [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" /> The planet had a Type I [[atmosphere]]<ref name="Atmosphere" /> that was breathable to [[human]]s and featured [[mountain]]ous terrain, including a [[Water|lake]]. Havoc [[Spaceport|Outpost]] was built into the cliffside overlooking the lake.<ref name="Blood Sisters" /> The planet was allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], who used Havoc Outpost for operations.<ref name="Helmet Collection 23" /> In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{RebelsDate|208}}</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the rebels and the [[Galactic Empire]], the human [[Spectres|rebel]] [[Sabine Wren]] was tasked with traveling to the planet to deliver the [[courier]] [[GNK-series power droid|droid]] [[EG-86]] to rebel forces representing [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]. With the help of her former associate, the human [[mercenary]] [[Ketsu Onyo]], Wren arrived at Havoc Outpost and delivered the [[droid]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet first appeared in "[[Blood Sisters]],"<ref name="Blood Sisters" /> the eighth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which premiered on [[November 18]], [[2015]].<ref name="Insider 169">{{InsiderCite|169|Star Wars Rebels: Season Two Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'': Season Two Episode Guide}}</ref> Concept art of the planet and its shipping outpost was done by [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Chris Glenn]] and was dated to [[September 26]], [[2014]].<ref name="Glenn">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/blood-sisters-concept-art-gallery|text="Blood Sisters" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> There were also multiple lighting concepts depicting the planet done in preparation for the episode.<ref name="Headed to Havoc">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/blood-sisters-concept-art-gallery|text="Blood Sisters" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 18}}</ref><ref name="Landing at Havoc">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/blood-sisters-concept-art-gallery|text="Blood Sisters" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 19}}</ref><ref name="Delivery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/blood-sisters-concept-art-gallery|text="Blood Sisters" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 20}}</ref> [[Jason Fry]], author of the [[June 24]], [[2025]] "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]" appendix of [[star system]]s published with [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] article on [[StarWars.com]], stated that Havoc Outpost was one of several locations excluded due to it only being known by a codename.<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref>
